findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 25 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 41 questions numbered 1-41; by section: u-introduction-functional-groups-in-synthesis 3, 25.1 13, u-functional-group-interconversion 2, 25.2 10, 25.3 7, 25.4 6.

Covers the whole chapter in order (introduction, 25.1 synthesis/retrosynthesis and terminology, FGI, 25.2 ethyl acetate, aniline, acetophenone, 25.3 paracetamol and aspirin, 25.4 AI and halicin, Interesting Information boxes). Comparison questions are answered as two-column tables. The chapter has no calculations. None repeats the exercise short questions (synthesis vs retrosynthesis, synthon-SE relation, disconnection, one FGI application, alcohol conversions and the chloronitrobenzene design are avoided). Book corrections followed: ethyl acetate SE acetic acid + ethanol; paracetamol Step IV on 4-nitrophenol (HO–C₆H₄⁻ + NO₂⁺), Step V SE phenol + nitric acid; pathogens become resistant; sulfur in halicin's rings.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
